model.title: Albuquerque Indian School Act of 2025
model.meta: Indian Affairs Committee · Sen. Martin Heinrich (D-NM)

summary.text: The bill would transfer approximately 9.89 acres of federally owned land in Albuquerque, New Mexico—formerly part of a historic Indian boarding school—into trust for the benefit of 19 Pueblos of New Mexico. The land would be required to support educational, health, cultural, business, and economic development for the Pueblos, while remaining subject to existing easements and utility agreements, and gaming would be prohibited on the property.
